Sculptural volume, rough hand-painted dry brush fantasy illustration, selective etched texture, aged materials, deep chiaroscuro, dominant charcoal and old iron with muted ivory and brown leather. Directional light from upper front LEFT. No photography, smooth 3D render, neon or cartoon. One symbolic anatomical human heart carved from warm dark red jasper with dull ivory veins, weathered organic sculptural form, not wet, not bloody. A compact clearly recognizable strong heart with thick intact vessels, muted deep red accent, no surrounding frame or glow.
